body: The scent of ink and paper clings to my fingers as I trace the familiar script on the envelope. The heat from the fire crackling in the hearth ignites like an ember against the chill of autumn. I close my eyes, inhaling deeply, letting the memory of their voice resonate within me. "Please," I whisper softly, "take care." My hand trembles slightly at the thought of confronting someone who has wronged us so grievously. Yet, in that moment, my heart swells with protectiveness towards them. Their safety now outweighs any anger or desire for vengeance. Instead, I step forward with a gentle strength, shielding them with the weight of my trust and love. "I will be here," I promise, "to watch over you." And they turn back into the embrace, grateful under the golden sky.
